participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

site.Description: Acquisition site, as coded by the source.

site_folder.Description: BIDS site folder under RawDataBIDS/ (some SITE_IDs are split into sub-sites, e.g. CMU_a/CMU_b).

dsm_iv_tr.Description: DSM-IV-TR diagnostic subtype. As in the source, 20 ASD participants are coded 'control' here; use `diagnosis` as the label.

handedness.Description: Handedness category, as coded by each site.

fiq.Description: Full-scale IQ (test type varies by site: FIQ_TEST_TYPE).

current_med_status.Description: Taking medication at the time of scan.
